card.who: Julie Kettlewell, 29, laid off from the laundry's presses in the summer; the laundry runs on with fewer hands. Owes Mickey's nine pounds she cannot pay. Can drive anything.
card.speak: Friendly, tired, proud about money. Makes a joke of being skint.
card.life: Rents 9 Chapel Lane, the house with the blue step. The cards in the newsagent's window every morning.
card.fire: The laundry shut the same month. She says the Hook is being emptied one building at a time.
card.rivals: Agar's firm handled the laundry's closing. Nobody got what they were owed.
